name: Universe 1
description: Geometry Dash mod menu with local gameplay modifiers, visual tools, icon preview, practice replays, and an animated interface.

keybind-noclip.name: Toggle Noclip
keybind-noclip.description: Toggle Noclip. Safe Mode determines whether the current attempt switches to Practice Mode.

keybind-speedhack.name: Toggle Speedhack
keybind-speedhack.description: Toggle the gameplay speed multiplier. Safe Mode determines whether the current attempt switches to Practice Mode.

keybind-record.name: Start / stop practice recorder
keybind-record.description: Record player input events during a Practice Mode session.

keybind-replay.name: Play saved practice replay
keybind-replay.description: Play the locally saved input recording in Practice Mode.

keybind-fps-bypass.name: Toggle FPS Bypass
keybind-fps-bypass.description: Toggle the game's render frame interval override.

fps-bypass-enabled.name: FPS Bypass
fps-bypass-enabled.description: Override the render frame interval using the configured FPS target.

fps-target.name: FPS target
fps-target.description: Target render frequency while FPS Bypass is enabled.

keybind-trajectory.name: Toggle player path trail
keybind-trajectory.description: Show or hide the recent player movement trail.

show-trajectory.name: Show player path trail
show-trajectory.description: Draw the recent movement path behind the player. This is not predictive physics.

keybind-hitboxes.name: Toggle hitboxes
keybind-hitboxes.description: Show or hide object collision rectangles.

show-hitboxes.name: Show object hitboxes
show-hitboxes.description: Draw object collision rectangles over the active level.

click-sound.name: Global click sound
click-sound.description: Play the supplied sound for mouse clicks and Android screen taps throughout Geometry Dash.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: When enabled, using Noclip or Speedhack switches the current attempt to Practice Mode. Turn it off to leave gameplay modifiers active in Normal Mode.

noclip.name: Noclip
noclip.description: Toggle collision bypass. With Safe Mode ON, modified attempts switch to Practice Mode; with Safe Mode OFF, Noclip remains active in Normal Mode.

speedhack-enabled.name: Speedhack
speedhack-enabled.description: Toggle local gameplay speed modification. Safe Mode ON switches modified attempts to Practice Mode; Safe Mode OFF allows the modifier in Normal Mode.

speedhack-speed.name: Speedhack multiplier
speedhack-speed.description: Gameplay speed multiplier, adjustable from 0.25x to 3.00x in the Universe panel.

icon-preview.name: Icon preview
icon-preview.description: Legacy compatibility toggle; icon browsing is available in the Universe Player tab and locked icons remain preview-only.

practice-tools.name: Practice tools
practice-tools.description: Enable local practice and testing helpers.

floating-button.name: Floating in-game panel button
floating-button.description: Show a large touch-friendly UNIV button on the gameplay screen. Useful on Android and available on desktop too.

keybind-projection.name: Toggle movement projection
keybind-projection.description: Show or hide a short straight-line projection based on recent player movement.

show-projection.name: Show movement projection
show-projection.description: Estimate a short path from recent player velocity and acceleration. It does not model portals, collisions, or future gameplay events.

preview-icon-id.name: Local icon override ID
preview-icon-id.description: Icon ID rendered for your local player when Local Icon Override is enabled. This does not unlock or save account icons.

local-icon-override.name: Local Icon Override
local-icon-override.description: Render the selected icon ID on your local player without changing account unlocks or saved icon selections.

floating-button-x.name: Floating button horizontal position
floating-button-x.description: Saved horizontal position of the draggable touch button.

floating-button-y.name: Floating button vertical position
floating-button-y.description: Saved vertical position of the draggable touch button.

panel-title.name: Panel title
panel-title.description: Custom title displayed at the top of the Universe overlay.

floating-button-label.name: Floating button label
floating-button-label.description: Custom text shown on the draggable in-game button.

panel-offset-x.name: Panel horizontal offset
panel-offset-x.description: Saved horizontal overlay offset, relative to screen width.

panel-offset-y.name: Panel vertical offset
panel-offset-y.description: Saved vertical overlay offset, relative to screen height.

preview-icon-type.name: Icon preview category
preview-icon-type.description: Select which icon category to preview and equip when the selected icon is already unlocked.

show-player-bounds.name: Show player bounds
show-player-bounds.description: Draw a local outline around the player's current sprite bounds. This is a visual reference, not the game's exact collision shape.

icon-primary-color.name: Local icon primary color
icon-primary-color.description: Primary tint used by the local-only icon override.

icon-secondary-color.name: Local icon secondary color
icon-secondary-color.description: Secondary tint used by the local-only icon override.

icon-glow-color.name: Local icon glow color
icon-glow-color.description: Glow tint used by the local-only icon override.

local-icon-glow.name: Local icon glow
local-icon-glow.description: Show a local glow on the overridden icon without changing account settings.
